'''Coromandel International Limited''' is an Indian [[agrochemicals]] company which makes [[crop protection]] products. Originally named Coromandel Fertilisers, the company makes fertilizers, pesticides and specialty nutrients. Coromandel International is part of [[Murugappa Group]] and a subsidiary of [[EID Parry]], which holds a 62.82% stake in the company.  

The company was founded in the early 1960s by IMC and [[Chevron U.S.A., Inc. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc.|Chevron Companies]] and [[EID Parry]]. It operates a retail business in the states of [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[Karnataka]] and [[Maharashtra]] through its Mana Gromor Centres.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/SB125558077864186837|author=Poh Si Teng|date=16 October 2009|accessdate= 26 October 2009|work=[[The Wall Street Journal]]|title=Fertilizers on Wheels}}</ref> It has sixteen manufacturing units located in [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[Tamil Nadu]], [[Maharashtra]], [[Gujarat]],  [[Rajasthan]], [[Madhya Pradesh]], [[Uttar Pradesh]] and [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. Its product line includes Gromor, Godavari, Paramfos, Parry Gold and Parry Super.<ref name=p>{{Cite web|title=Coromandel International Consolidated Profit & Loss account, Coromandel International Financial Statement & Accounts|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/financials/coromandelinternational/consolidated-profit-lossVI/CI45|access-date=2020-07-01|website=www.moneycontrol.com|language=en}}</ref><ref name=b>{{Cite web|title=Coromandel International Consolidated Balance Sheet, Coromandel International Financial Statement & Accounts|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/financials/coromandelinternational/consolidated-balance-sheetVI/CI45|access-date=2020-07-01|website=www.moneycontrol.com|language=en}}</ref>

Coromandel was ranked #16 on [[Business Today (Business Magazine)|''Business Today'''s]] 2009 list of the Best Companies to work for in India.<ref>{{cite news |last=Sharma |first=E. Kumar |date=8 January 2009 |title=The other good employers |work=[[Business Today (Business Magazine)|Business Today]] |url=http://businesstoday.intoday.in/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=9429&completeview=1 |accessdate=26 October 2009}}</ref> The company confers an annual [[Borlaug Award]] for outstanding Indian science in the field of agriculture and environment.<ref>{{cite news |title=Two IARI scientists get Borlaug Award 2012 |newspaper=The Weekend Leader |url=http://www.theweekendleader.com/Headlines/76/two-iari-scientists-get-borlaug-award-2012.html |accessdate=26 December 2012}}</ref>

== Businesses ==
The Company's Crop Protection products are marketed in India and internationally, offering a range of technical and formulation products. 

The Company has a research, development, and regulatory effort, supporting the businesses in process development and new product development. 

=== Phosphatic fertilizer ===
The Company is India's second largest manufacturer and marketer of [[phosphate fertiliser]].

=== Specialty nutrients ===
The Specialty Nutrients business focuses on products such as [[sulphur pastilles]], water-soluble fertiliser and secondary and [[micronutrient]] segments. The Company is India's leading marketer of [[organic fertiliser]] and also offers [[Biopesticide|biopesticides]]. Speciality nutrients cater to the needs of particular crops at different growth stages. 

=== Retail ===
As of 2025 the company operated a network of around 1100 retail outlets across [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[Telangana]], [[Karnataka]], TamilNadu and [[Maharashtra]]. Through these outlets, the company offers farming services including crop advisory, [[soil testing]] and [[farm mechanization]] to some 3 million farmers. 

One store covers 30-40 villages and caters to some 5,000 farmer families.Overall the Retail outlets has connects more than 3 million farmers.
